prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original transparent PNG pixel-art game character sprite for Brokk Town.
Primary request: a studious little feature-discovery robot wearing large round reading glasses and a burgundy waistcoat, holding an open cream-paged book in both hands and thoughtfully reading it. Compact gray metal head, warm amber eyes visible through round glasses, small antenna, short legs, tiny brass accents. A friendly scholarly personality that reads clearly at 60 pixels tall.
Style/medium: crisp cozy village-game pixel art, chunky hard stepped pixel edges, dark navy outlines, restrained colors, top-down three-quarter view with front and right side visible, upper-left warm lighting. Match the original Brokk Town sprites without copying an existing game.
Composition/framing: full body isolated at the center of a square canvas, robot occupies roughly 80 percent of the image height, enough empty margin for the full antenna and feet.
Scene/backdrop: TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Output a genuine RGBA PNG image with alpha=0 outside the robot, book, and clothing. The file MUST contain a real alpha channel. No visible checkerboard. A checkerboard painted into opaque RGB pixels is unacceptable.
Constraints: exactly one robot with one open book; no building, desk, chair, scenery, floor, shadow, glow outside the sprite, letters, words, text, logos or watermark.
outcome: Single fresh generation with genuine RGBA transparency; generated alpha preserved.
